I'm not withholding criticism to punish you or to make a point about accommodating me. The issue is that there's nothing concrete in front of me to praise or critique.

Paste it — the plan, the outline, even a rough summary — and I'll give you a straight read. Positives included, and I'll tell you plainly where I think the weak joints are. That's more useful to you than a thumbs-up I can't back up.
